name: command-31
description: A launcher that shows an instant calculator result as the first item for simple math.

files.content: "use client" import * as React from "react" import { CalculatorIcon, NotebookPenIcon, TimerIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Command, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandInput, CommandItem, CommandList, CommandShortcut, } from "@workspace/ui/components/command" function calculate(input: string) { const match = input .replace(/\s/g, "") .match(/^(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)([+\-*/x])(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)$/) if (!match) return null const a = Number(match[1]) const b = Number(match[3]) switch (match[2]) { case "+": return a + b case "-": return a - b case "*": case "x": return a * b case "/": return b === 0 ? null : a / b default: return null } } export default function InlineCalculatorResult() { const [query, setQuery] = React.useState("128 * 12") const result = calculate(query) return ( {result !== null ? ( {query} = {Number(result.toFixed(6)).toLocaleString()} copy ) : null} Type a sum like 42 + 8. Notes Timer ) }
